//ForwardedHeaders: TrustAllProxies is sound here ONLY because the Railway edge terminates TLS and appends the real client address to X-Forwarded-For, so a client cannot choose the address the server sees. If this ever runs behind an edge that passes inbound X-Forwarded-For through untouched, replace this with KnownProxies/KnownNetworks or rate limiting and audit attribution become spoofable (andy-auth#125).
